abstract: During a 34-year period 12 children were seen with testicular tumors. Of 8 benign tumors 7 were treated by orchiectomy and 1 by local excision only. The 4 malignant tumors were managed by orchiectomy and 1 boy also received adjunctive chemotherapy. All patients are alive and have had no recurrent tumors after 1 1/2 to 34 years of followup. Because testicular tumors usually are less aggressive in prepubertal children, the chance of cure by orchiectomy alone in this age group is good. However, the potential of these tumors for metastases makes it imperative that they be observed closely.
abstract_ja: 34年間に、精巣腫瘍のある小児12例を診察した。良性腫瘍8例のうち7例は精巣摘除術、1例は局所切除のみで治療された。悪性腫瘍4例は精巣摘除術で治療され、うち1例の男児はさらに化学療法を併用した。全患者は生存しており、1年半から34年のフォローアップ期間中に再発腫瘍は認められていない。精巣腫瘍は通常、思春期前の小児では悪性度が低いため、この年齢層では精巣摘除術のみでも治癒の可能性が高い。しかし、これらの腫瘍は転移能を有するため、注意深い経過観察が不可欠である。
